{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Radish_Pie|Radish Pie]]

'''Radish pie''' is a savory [[Cookbook:Pie|pie]] suitable for a vegetarian diet.  Radishes, fresh goat cheese, and walnuts give the pie a unique taste, which is most flavorful when served cold.

==Ingredients==
*1–2 bunches red [[Cookbook:Radish|radish]]es
*1–2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
*8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (227 g) [[Cookbook:Phyllo Dough|phyllo]] dough
*1 red [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dry [[Cookbook:Sherry|sherry]] wine
*2 large [[Cookbook:egg|egg]]s
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|yolk]]
*¾ cup (177 ml) heavy [[Cookbook:cream|cream]]
*4 oz (113 g) fresh goat [[Cookbook:cheese|cheese]] 
*¾ cup (177 ml) broken [[Cookbook:walnuts|walnut]] pieces
*⅓ cup (80 ml) fresh Italian [[Cookbook:parsley|parsley]]

==Procedure==
[[File:RadishPieSlice250px.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Slice of radish pie]]
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (175°C).
#Wash the radishes well, remove and discard tops. Put radishes into a small [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] and drizzle with olive oil. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for about an hour. Let them cool and then cut into small cubes.
#Use half the butter to grease a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]], and then line it with pieces of [[wikipedia:Phyllo|phyllo dough]], covering the pan evenly. Tuck any stray bits under to make a nice edge.
#Heat the remaining butter in a large pan and sauté the onion in it for about 5 minutes. Add the wine and diced radishes, then cook for another minute. Remove from heat and pour into the pastry shell.
#In a bowl, mix together the eggs and cream, and then pour over the vegetables in the pie crust. Crumble the goat cheese over the cream.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] the pie in a preheated oven at aforementioned temperature for 20 minutes.
#Add the walnuts and bake for another 15–20 minutes.
#Remove the pie from the oven and top it with the chopped parsley.
#Let cool completely before serving.
==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Use fewer radishes for milder taste, or add more according to your own taste.
*The radishes can be baked the day before and then refrigerated until you make the pie.
*For a professional look, garnish each serving with a sprig of parsley.
